name: ULME arbitrary approved-user spending
summary: buyMiner(user, usdt) was public and passed its caller-supplied user directly to USDT.transferFrom without requiring user == msg.sender or another authorization. The attacker invoked it for 100 holders who had approved ULME, forcing their USDT through the ULME/USDT pair while sandwiching those trades.

loss.notes: The exploit receipt contains 100 USDT transfers from distinct approved users to ULME totaling 250,817.770742650963321153 USDT, followed by the same total from ULME to the pair. The users received no asset in return. The pair's 200,170.825418687386914428 USDT transaction-local net inflow and the attacker's roughly $50,000 sandwich profit are consequences of these forced trades, not alternative measures of the users' gross loss.

ageReset.description: An internal setRoter() call set the PancakeSwap router in slot 0xe and USDT in slot 0xd. Before this transaction buyMiner had zero-valued swap dependencies; this configuration made its arbitrary approved-user spending path operational.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit transaction, receipt and full call trace; the direct deployment; all target setter transactions through the exploit; runtime history; and extracted verified source. buyMiner(user, usdt) accepts any user, increases usdt by 10%, then calls USDT.transferFrom(user, ULME, usdt) without authenticating msg.sender. It swaps the USDT for ULME to fixed address 0x25812c28cbc971f7079879a62aacbc93936784a2 and moves the output back to ULME, leaving the selected users with no proceeds. The exploit made 100 successful buyMiner calls. Receipt transfers show 100 distinct users sent exactly 250,817.770742650963321153 USDT to ULME, which forwarded the same amount to the ULME/USDT pair. The pair retained 200,170.825418687386914428 net USDT after the attacker's surrounding swaps. ULME was created top-level by 0x4a005e5e40ce2b827c873ca37af77e6873e37203 at block 22313585:99, but its router and USDT addresses were initially zero. Transaction 0x01cb90ac3741611863c1a4c64939ccf80372805dc4828738e3113068fbdfbad1 called setRoter internally at block 22314002:75, writing USDT to slot 0xd and PancakeSwap Router V2 to slot 0xe; both remained unchanged through the exploit. Later _dis and sale_date updates did not authenticate buyMiner or select its spend/swap dependencies. The 15,208-byte direct runtime hashes to 0x28db6b9fb2bdb50711740449a157c2af3b532fcdc55614c3486854bfe33b058e at configuration and immediately before exploitation. The operational vulnerable state was 493,850 seconds old.
